correctness.rationale: The frozen table's upper-left entry is undefined as printed (u); it must equal ν by reflection of the (+1,+1) event. The complete repaired RESULT.md makes just that correction. Write a=α−1, c=2a, d=2−α. The step density H/(3α) integrates to one since 2+2a+c+d=3α. For y>0 the central branch contributes H(y/2)=2+1_(y<c) to 2PH. For y<a both outer inverses contribute a combined 3: the indicator thresholds at ±(4−3α) occur in complementary pairs, since |4−3α|≤a. For a<y<d only the right inverse survives and has H=1, and for y>d neither survives. These are exactly the values of 2H, up to null breakpoints, also when knots coincide at endpoints. The cited unique ergodic ACIM therefore identifies the density. Its central mass is 2/3 and the lag-one zero event is |x|≤1/4, of mass 1/(2α). For lag two the central-central path gives |x|≤1/8; the two reflected paths through an outer branch give 1/4<|x|≤b=(α+1/2)/4. Splitting the wing integrals at a, with 1/4≤a≤b≤1/2, yields 1−3/(4α) after adding the core. Subtracting 4/9 gives the negative lag-one covariance and the unique lag-two zero at 27/20. Same-sign adjacency has mass ν=(3−2α)/(12α) on either sign, by integrating above (α+1/2)/2 and reflecting. Opposite adjacent signs are impossible, and stationarity plus sign symmetry with ± marginals 1/6 forces the corrected table. After two positive symbols the state cannot exceed 2−α≤(α+1/2)/2, ruling out another positive symbol; reflection and the opposite-sign exclusion complete the triple bound. Ergodicity converts these stationary cylinder masses to typical-orbit frequencies. The frozen exact-rational checker was inspected but not executed; the piecewise argument supplies the continuum and endpoint cases.
